# CodingPlan.org

> Compare AI coding subscriptions side by side — pricing, models, usage limits, and supported tools.

CodingPlan.org is an independent comparison site for AI coding plan subscriptions. We track pricing and features across major platforms so developers can find the best plan for their workflow.

## Pages

- [Chinese Homepage](https://codingplan.org): 国内 AI 编程套餐对比 — 智谱 GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、火山引擎方舟、阿里云百炼、小米 MiMo、OpenCode Go
- [English Homepage](https://codingplan.org/en): International AI coding plan comparison — Claude Code, GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, Qwen
- [Deals & Invite Codes](https://codingplan.org/deals): Current discounts, invite codes and first-purchase offers across platforms
- [Leaderboard](https://codingplan.org/leaderboard): Price-performance ranking of all 9 platforms with entry price, quota scale and model lineup
- [Changelog](https://codingplan.org/changelog): Timeline of pricing, model and availability changes across platforms
- [GLM vs Kimi](https://codingplan.org/blogs/glm-vs-kimi): Zhipu GLM Coding Plan vs Kimi Code Plan head-to-head comparison

## Platforms Covered

### International (English page)

- **Claude Code** by Anthropic: $20–$200/mo. Models: Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5. The gold standard for AI coding.
- **GLM Coding Plan** by Zhipu AI (Z.ai): $18–$168/mo (yearly $12.6–$117.6/mo, -30%). Models: GLM-5.2, GLM-5.1, GLM-5-Turbo, GLM-5, GLM-4.7. Weekly Credits (Lite 10K / Pro 60K / Max 140K). 4 MCP tools included. GLM-5.2 is #1 open-source & #2 global on LMArena Code.
- **MiniMax Token Plan**: $10–$80/mo. Models: M3, M2.7, M2.7-highspeed. Up to 100+ TPS inference speed. 4 tiers (Starter / Plus / Max / Max HS).
- **Kimi Code Plan** by Moonshot AI: $0–$99/mo (5 tiers). Model: Kimi K3 (2.8T params, 1M context, launched 2026/7/17) + K2.6. 100 TPS, weekly quota refresh.
- **Qwen Coding Plan** by Alibaba Cloud: $10–$50/mo. Models: Qwen3.5-Plus, Qwen3-Max, Qwen3-Coder, GLM-5, Kimi-K2.5, MiniMax-M2.5. Multi-model switching.

### OpenCode Go

- **OpenCode Go** by Anomaly: $5 first month, then $10/mo with 6x usage value. 18 open-source models: Grok 4.5, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.1, GPT 5.6 Luna, Kimi K3/K2.7 Code/K2.6, MiMo-V2.5/-Pro, MiniMax M3/M2.7, Qwen3.8 Max/Qwen3.7 Max/Plus/Qwen3.6 Plus, DeepSeek V4 Pro/V4 Flash, Hy3. Dollar-based limits ($12/5h, $30/week, $60/month). OpenAI / Anthropic compatible APIs work with OpenCode or any agent.

### China (Chinese page)

- **智谱 GLM**: ¥118–¥1078/月（连包年 7 折后约 ¥94.4–¥862.4/月）. Models: GLM-5.2, GLM-5.1, GLM-5-Turbo, GLM-5, GLM-4.7. 4 类 MCP 工具内置，每周 Credits 制度.
- **MiniMax**: ¥49–¥469/月. Models: M3, M2.7, M2.7-highspeed, M2.5, H3, Speech 2.8, Music 3.0. 全模态共享额度，1M 上下文.
- **Kimi**: ¥49–¥699/月（5 档 Adagio/Andante/Moderato/Allegretto/Allegro）. Model: Kimi K3 (2026/7/17 发布) + K2.6. Moderato 起 K3 可用，Allegro 解锁 1M 超长对话.
- **火山引擎方舟**: 限时 9.9 元起（刊例 ¥40/月，受邀再 9.5 折）. 8+ 款模型自由切换，Auto 模式，GLM-5.2 等热门模型限时加量 4 倍.
- **小米 MiMo**: ¥39–¥659/月（包年 88 折）。V2.5 全系列模型 + MiMo Claw 正式版（加购 ¥233.80/年）。5/26 起全档 Credits 升级 5-8 倍（492-9,840 亿/年）.
- **阿里云百炼**: ¥40–¥200/月. 千问系列 + 第三方模型，Lite 已停售，Pro 每日限量抢购.
- **腾讯云 Coding Plan**: 已下线（2026/4/22），仅历史参考.
- **白云智算**: 按量 API，无固定月费；注册实名 ¥150 + 首调 ¥300 代金券.

Prices and quotas can change. Verify current information on each provider's official website.
